edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making caller the privileged owner
onlyOnwer modifier compares msg.sender against owner for privilege check
constructor stores the provided token interface into state variable token
getreward uses the stored token contract to execute the reward transfer
givefeedback keys check, redeemcode and feedback mappings on msg.sender
_number parameter is validated and written into feedback[msg.sender]
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random redeem code generation
givefeedback depends on block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable timestamp source
keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp) result is assigned to local code
computed local code is stored in redeemcode[msg.sender]
givefeedback writes the submitted rating into feedback[msg.sender]
givefeedback sets check[msg.sender]=true to prevent duplicate feedback
_code parameter is compared against stored redeemcode[msg.sender]
getreward reads redeemcode[msg.sender] to validate the provided code
getreward branches on feedback[msg.sender] to select the reward amount
getreward reads rewardcheck and sends tokens to msg.sender
getreward reads allocation[rating] to determine the transfer amount
getreward performs the external token transfer before finalizing state
rewardcheck[msg.sender] is set to true only after the external token transfer completes
getreward updates rewardcheck after interacting with an external token contract
onlyOnwer gates changerewardperct so only owner can change rewards
one is written into allocation[1]
two is written into allocation[2]
three is written into allocation[3]
four is written into allocation[4]
five is written into allocation[5]
changerewardperct mutates the allocation mapping
onlyOnwer gates the native fund withdrawal
amount parameter controls how much native balance is transferred
owner address receives the native transfer in Withdraw
Withdraw executes owner.transfer(amount)
onlyOnwer gates the token withdrawal
_amount parameter sets the token amount sent to owner
WithdrawToken calls the stored token contract to move funds
WithdrawToken invokes the external token contract via transfer

normalization_plan.reason: Input rating parameter is only meaningful as the argument written into the feedback state within givefeedback
Redeem code parameter is only used for the equality check inside getreward
Parameter exists solely to assign allocation[1] inside changerewardperct
Parameter exists solely to assign allocation[2] inside changerewardperct
Parameter exists solely to assign allocation[3] inside changerewardperct
Parameter exists solely to assign allocation[4] inside changerewardperct
Parameter exists solely to assign allocation[5] inside changerewardperct
Withdrawal amount parameter is consumed only by the native transfer in Withdraw
Token amount parameter is consumed only by the token transfer in WithdrawToken
Local redeem code temp is a pure intermediate of givefeedback's randomness computation
Constructor token address parameter is only used to initialize the token state variable
